description:
Carry projection mode and style as their enums in the render report, deleting the token functions.

## Background

`mode_token` and `style_token` (`crates/jit/src/commands/project.rs:55-69`) restate serde renames of the enums in `config.rs:1103-1145`, to fill `String` fields (`project.rs:33,35`) at `:211-212`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Projection mode and style are declared through the macro, and the render report holds them as enums.
- [hard] REQ-02: `mode_token` and `style_token` are gone, and the report's JSON is byte-identical.
title: Projection mode and style reach output typed
